provenance.method: Static approved request-preparation and existing native CLI contracts before operator implementation. Python serializes independently specified expected bytes; no proposed operator code, generated model output or replay observation supplied expectations. Native parity tests call unchanged native APIs directly, not extracted shared CLI runners.
provenance.limits: Separate assistant authorship, not independent-person review, authentication or proof of execution. Native API parity is compatibility evidence; business expectations remain the existing frozen suites.
provenance.inspectionInput: Previously captured invented fixed rehearsal carrier from existing public fixtures, retained only as a native API compatibility input; its existence is not independent proof of execution or approval.
provenance.mismatchInput: New copied request changes only the first literal expected task revision to 9 and its manifest suite-byte binding. The original frozen source files stay unchanged. Static contract expects one early task mismatch; expected behavior is not derived from a run.

help:
Usage: foundry prepare --intake FILE --requirements FILE --model FILE --suite FILE --manifest FILE
       foundry review
       foundry proposal check|execute
       foundry process json|svg
       foundry inspect
       foundry revisions

All reports use the native tool contracts. Only proposal execute runs a candidate.
